svg.title: Value of perfect information for the forecast
svg.desc: Forecast good (0.59) gives MEU 95 by leaving; bad (0.41) gives MEU 53 by taking; expected MEU 77.8 vs 70 without the forecast; VPI = 7.8.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: VPI(Forecast): expected MEU after observing − MEU now
